HEADER.TITLE: Connect WhatsApp manually
HEADER.DESCRIPTION: Follow these steps to prepare your Meta account and connect your number to Chatwoot.

APP.TITLE: Create or select a Meta app
APP.DESCRIPTION: Your WhatsApp number must belong to a Meta app with the WhatsApp use case enabled.
APP.ITEM_1: Open {metaDevelopers} and sign in with an administrator account.
APP.ITEM_2: Create a new app, or select the app you already use for this WhatsApp number.
APP.ITEM_3: Choose the option to connect with customers through WhatsApp.
APP.ITEM_4: Select the business portfolio that owns, or will own, the WhatsApp number.
APP.VIDEO_DESCRIPTION: This short walkthrough shows where to start a new app in Meta Developers.

NUMBER.TITLE: Add your phone number and get its IDs
NUMBER.DESCRIPTION: Add and verify the production number in your Meta app, then copy the two identifiers shown in API Setup.
NUMBER.ITEM_1: Open the WhatsApp use case in your Meta app and choose API Setup.
NUMBER.ITEM_2: In the Send and receive messages section, open the From selector.
NUMBER.ITEM_3: Select an existing production number, or choose Add phone number.
NUMBER.ITEM_4: Complete the WhatsApp business profile requested by Meta.
NUMBER.ITEM_5: Verify the phone number using the OTP sent by SMS or voice call.
NUMBER.ITEM_6: Copy the Phone Number ID and WhatsApp Business Account ID shown in API Setup.
NUMBER.VIDEO_TITLE: Watch: Add a phone number and find its IDs
NUMBER.VIDEO_DESCRIPTION: This walkthrough shows how to add or select a production number and copy the identifiers from Meta.

TOKEN.TITLE: Generate a permanent access token
TOKEN.DESCRIPTION: Create a Meta system user with access to your app and WhatsApp Business Account.
TOKEN.ITEM_1: Open Meta Business Settings and go to Users → System users.
TOKEN.ITEM_2: Create an admin system user, or select an existing one.
TOKEN.ITEM_3: Assign your Meta app and WhatsApp Business Account to the system user.
TOKEN.ITEM_4: Grant full control for the assigned WhatsApp assets.
TOKEN.ITEM_5: Generate a token for your Meta app and set its expiration to Never.
TOKEN.ITEM_6: Select whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging, then copy the token.
TOKEN.VIDEO_TITLE: Watch: Generate a permanent access token
TOKEN.VIDEO_DESCRIPTION: This walkthrough shows how to select your Meta app, choose a non-expiring token, and grant the required WhatsApp permissions.
TOKEN.WARNING: Meta shows the token only once. Copy it before closing the dialog.

DETAILS.APP_SECRET_HELP: Find it in your Meta app under App settings > Basic. It is used to verify incoming webhooks.

REVIEW.TITLE: Create your WhatsApp inbox
REVIEW.DESCRIPTION: Review the number details and choose a name for the inbox.
REVIEW.VERIFIED: Your Meta number and access token are valid.
REVIEW.INBOX_NAME_HELP: We generated this name from your verified Meta business name. You can change it.

VERIFY.TITLE: Verify your connection
VERIFY.DESCRIPTION: Chatwoot is checking number access and configuring your Meta webhook.
VERIFY.SUCCESS: Your WhatsApp number is connected and ready for agent assignment.
VERIFY.RETRY_ERROR: We could not retry the webhook setup. Try again.

ERRORS.IDS_REQUIRED: Enter the Phone Number ID and WhatsApp Business Account ID.

آپ نے کامیابی سے اپنا Facebook پیج Chatwoot کے ساتھ مربوط کر لیا ہے۔ اگلی بار جب کوئی صارف آپ کے پیج کو پیغام بھیجے گا، تو گفتگو خود بخود آپ کے ان باکس میں ظاہر ہو جائے گی۔
ہم آپ کو ایک ویجیٹ اسکرپٹ بھی فراہم کر رہے ہیں جسے آپ آسانی سے اپنی ویب سائٹ پر شامل کر سکتے ہیں۔ جب یہ آپ کی ویب سائٹ پر فعال ہو جائے گا، تو صارفین آپ کو براہ راست آپ کی ویب سائٹ سے پیغام بھیج سکیں گے بغیر کسی بیرونی ٹول کی مدد کے اور گفتگو یہاں، Chatwoot پر ظاہر ہو گی۔
کمال ہے، ہے نا؟ ہم واقعی کوشش کرتے ہیں :)

HELP_TEXT.TITLE: Using Slack Integration
HELP_TEXT.BODY:
With this integration, all of your incoming conversations will be synced to the ***{selectedChannelName}*** channel in your Slack workspace. You can manage all your customer conversations right within the channel and never miss a message.

Here are the main features of the integration:

**Respond to conversations from within Slack:** To respond to a conversation in the ***{selectedChannelName}*** Slack channel, simply type out your message and send it as a thread. This will create a response back to the customer through Chatwoot. It's that simple!

 **Create private notes:** If you want to create private notes instead of replies, start your message with ***`note:`***. This ensures that your message is kept private and won't be visible to the customer.

**Associate an agent profile:** If the person who replied on Slack has an agent profile in Chatwoot under the same email, the replies will be associated with that agent profile automatically. This means you can easily track who said what and when. On the other hand, when the replier doesn't have an associated agent profile, the replies will appear from the bot profile to the customer.
HELP_TEXT.BODY_ALERT:
With this integration, all of your incoming conversations will be synced to the ***{selectedChannelName}*** channel in your Slack workspace, so your team can pick them up as soon as they come in.

This integration is set to **Alerts only**, which means the Slack thread is a safe space for internal discussion. Anything your team posts there stays in Slack and is never sent to the customer.

**Respond to the customer from Chatwoot:** Open the conversation from the link shared in the thread and reply from the Chatwoot dashboard. Replies and private notes added in Chatwoot keep appearing in the Slack thread, so everyone stays in the loop.

LOGIN_PROBLEMS.NAME: Login problems
LOGIN_PROBLEMS.SUMMARY: See when login complaints start increasing.
LOGIN_PROBLEMS.CONDITION: A customer says they cannot sign in to their account, including failed password resets and verification codes that never arrive. Exclude questions about changing a password while already signed in.

MISSING_ORDER_UPDATES.NAME: Missing order updates
MISSING_ORDER_UPDATES.CONDITION: A customer says an order confirmation, shipping update, or delivery notice did not arrive, or arrived for the wrong order. Exclude customers asking where a parcel is when they did receive the tracking email.

COMPETITOR_MENTIONS.NAME: Competitor mentions
COMPETITOR_MENTIONS.SUMMARY: Find conversations worth following up on.
COMPETITOR_MENTIONS.CONDITION: A customer compares us with a competing product, says they are evaluating one, or mentions they may switch. Exclude customers who moved to us from a competitor and are asking how to import their data.

FEATURE_REQUESTS.NAME: Feature requests
FEATURE_REQUESTS.SUMMARY: Keep a running count of conversations about unmet needs.
FEATURE_REQUESTS.CONDITION: A customer asks for a capability the product does not currently offer, or asks whether something is possible and it is not. Exclude questions about how to use a feature that already exists.

REFUND_REQUESTS.NAME: Refund requests
REFUND_REQUESTS.SUMMARY: Bring a consistent definition to your weekly refund request count.
REFUND_REQUESTS.CONDITION: A customer asks for money back on a payment they already made, including duplicate charges and refunds after cancelling. Exclude questions about the refund policy and requests for a discount.

CANCELLATION_INTENT.NAME: Cancellation intent
CANCELLATION_INTENT.SUMMARY: Find customers who may need a conversation before they leave.
CANCELLATION_INTENT.CONDITION: A customer says they intend to cancel, will not renew, or plan to stop using the product. Exclude requests to reduce seats or downgrade, and cancellations the customer takes back in the same conversation.

PAYMENT_FAILURES.NAME: Payment failures
PAYMENT_FAILURES.SUMMARY: Spot customers who are blocked from paying.
PAYMENT_FAILURES.CONDITION: A customer says a payment, checkout, or invoice payment failed, or their card was declined. Exclude refund requests, disputes about completed charges, and general questions about payment methods.

PRODUCT_ERRORS.NAME: Product errors
PRODUCT_ERRORS.SUMMARY: See when errors and crashes start spreading.
PRODUCT_ERRORS.CONDITION: A customer reports an error, crash, unavailable service, or severe slowness that prevents them from completing a task. Exclude sign-in problems and questions about how to use a working feature.

ISSUE_STILL_UNRESOLVED.NAME: Issue still unresolved
ISSUE_STILL_UNRESOLVED.SUMMARY: Find conversations that need another pass.
ISSUE_STILL_UNRESOLVED.CONDITION: A customer says a suggested fix did not work, the same problem returned, or their issue remains after support said it was resolved. Exclude first-time reports and requests only asking for a status update.

ESCALATION_REQUESTS.NAME: Escalation requests
ESCALATION_REQUESTS.SUMMARY: Surface requests that need prompt attention.
ESCALATION_REQUESTS.CONDITION: A customer explicitly asks for a human agent, manager, specialist, or higher support tier because their issue has not been resolved. Exclude routine transfers and sales requests.
